title: All Eyes On OPEC+
summary:
Awaiting OPEC's October production decision
Several months into the Covid-19 pandemic, OPEC+ was faced with a collapse in oil demand due to widespread lockdowns. So, in April 2020, the cartel agreed to a production cut of 9.7 million barrels per day (Mb/d) representing about 10% of global crude oil output. In July 2020, OPEC+ reduced the cuts to 7.7 Mb/d.
